reports.headline: Gunshots at the Old Lodge
reports.body: Gunshots have been heard after sunset around the old hunting lodge {landmark}, {dir} of the village. Nobody has lived there since the hunter who built it went missing, and his rifle was never found. {name} went up to see who was shooting and found the lodge empty and the door open. Shots were heard again the next night, closer to the trees.

reports.headline: Someone Is Still Hunting Up There
reports.body: Woodcutters say that {landmark}, at dusk, they keep hearing a rifle from the old hunting lodge {dir} of here, though the place has stood empty for years. {name} says the shots come in pairs, and that nothing ever comes out of the trees afterwards. Families are asked to keep children away from the lodge after dark.

reports.headline: A Rifle Fired With No One Holding It
reports.body: Travellers passing {landmark} {dir} of the village {dist} heard a single shot from the old hunting lodge and saw no one at the windows. {name}, who used to hunt with the man who kept it, went as far as the trees and turned back, and says the scope on the sill was turned to face the road, which it never was.

reports.headline: Tracks That End in the Woods
reports.body: {name} followed a deer trail past the hunting lodge {dir} of here {dist} and found a line of boot prints walking out into the trees, then stopping dead in open ground. No prints coming back. The hunting stands out there have bullet holes in them, fresh, all fired from the direction of the lodge.
